votes.motion: Accept the minutes of the September 7 meeting.
votes.quote: upon a motion by commissioner mendoza to accept the minutes and a second by commissioner may, and with no further discussion, the motion passed unanimously.

votes.motion: Set the Columbarium Niche Wall rate at $1200.00 per niche (holds 2 cremations, includes engraving), with only Leominster Monument doing the engraving.
votes.quote: a motion by chairman may was made to set the rate of $1200.00 per niche, which would hold 2 cremations, and would also include the engraving.

votes.motion: Pay for the new Ferris mower, with the understanding that a letter stating the mower is Cemetery Dept property will follow.
votes.quote: after some discussion a motion was made by commissioner may to pay for the new mower, understanding that a letter would be forthcoming.
a motion was made by commissioner tyler to adjourn, seconded by commissioner may, with no further discussion, the meeting was adjourned at 9:11 pm
